lines.en: I crawl slowly along the leaf vein.
I move in loops, arching and stretching.

lines.zh: 绿色的身子比叶子深一点
lines.en: My green body is a shade deeper than the leaf.
My short feet grip the leaf surface.
At the leaf edge I stop.
The leaf edge has a ring of teeth.

lines.zh: 我嚼着走，一路留下缺口
lines.en: I chew as I go, leaving notches.
I won't step onto anything else.
The leaf sways and I cling tighter.

lines.zh: 头抬起来，找下一处嫩叶
lines.en: I raise my head to find fresh leaf.
I'm heavy and crawl slowly.

lines.zh: 叶面上的绒毛滑，我小心
lines.en: The fuzz is slick. I'm careful.
I circle the leaf stalk once.

lines.zh: 只要在这片叶上，就没事
lines.en: As long as I'm on this leaf, I'm fine.
I fold my body into a half circle.
A few more bites and I'm grown.
I lie under the leaf, chewing slowly.
My body swells and contracts.
All I need is one leaf.
The ground is far. I don't look.
My skin has a faint sheen.
A hand is coming toward me.

lines.zh: 我缩在叶背，一动不敢动。
lines.en: I curl under the leaf and dare not move.
Soon I'll be spinning my cocoon.

lines.zh: 叶上还留着上一只的痕
lines.en: Old feeding marks are still on the leaf.
I twist my head slowly to one side.
My belly is full; I move awkwardly.

lines.zh: 这片叶子快被我吃穿了
lines.en: I've almost eaten through this leaf.
You're huge. I'm tiny.
You've set your hand at the leaf's edge.
Are you going to move me elsewhere?
Don't put me on the ground. I'd die.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只能看到一点你
lines.en: I look up and see only part of you.

lines.zh: 你的手指比我的身子还宽
lines.en: Your finger is wider than my body.
I'm eating, not looking.

lines.zh: 你身上没有叶子的味道
lines.en: You don't smell of leaves.

lines.zh: 停下咀嚼，嘴边还挂着叶子。
lines.en: I stop chewing, a leaf still on my lip.

lines.zh: 这片叶子是我的，别拿走
lines.en: This leaf is mine. Don't take it.
I curl into a ball and freeze.
Green juice seeps out.
My body has a dent.
I arch and curl tighter.
I struggle toward the leaf vein.
That slowed me a lot.
My skin is a little torn.
I stop and chew no more.
You hurt me. Really.
One more and I won't last.
I only eat leaves. Nothing else.
That's not a leaf in your hand.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，不是我的食物
lines.en: I sniff. Not my food.

lines.zh: 你把叶子递过来就对了
lines.en: Hand me a leaf and that's right.
I'll keep chewing my own.
I can't stop, or I'll starve.
This leaf is plenty.

lines.zh: 你换个叶子我会更高兴
lines.en: A different leaf would please me more.
I only know the shape of veins.
Other things, I don't understand.
You touch me and I curl up.

lines.zh: 我的身子被推着滑了半寸
lines.en: I'm nudged half an inch across the leaf.
Nearly fell. I gripped hard.
A finger grazes my back.
A small mark left on my skin.
I slowly uncurl and crawl on.

lines.zh: 叶子被你压得往下一沉
lines.en: The leaf dips under your pressure.
Don't flick me. I'll move myself.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我停了一会儿
lines.en: That bump made me pause a while.
I grip the vein and don't let go.
I'm still only a caterpillar.
Ask me after the cocoon.
Two caterpillars, one leaf.
This leaf is enough for both of us.
Don't lie on top of me.
We'll each eat one side.

lines.zh: 叶上的缺口会连成一片
lines.en: Our bites will join into one.
By then, we'll fly.
For now, let's fill our bellies.
Eat slowly. No rush.
I only eat. I don't pick up.
Things you set down, I don't touch.
There's only leaf pulp in my mouth.
Only you could carry me off.
There's nothing else on this leaf.
I crawl over to look.
Not a leaf. I'll move away.
Don't set things beside me.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，我只要叶子。
lines.en: I do not eat that; I only want leaves.
A leaf is enough.
I have nothing to attack with.
One reach from you and I'm finished.
I'm on the leaf. You're below.
I try to shrink into the veins.
My body is far too soft.
Only the leaf can shelter me.
You'll pick me up, I expect.
I'm holding on. Don't pull.
This leaf won't protect me.
I just want to finish this meal.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了整片叶
lines.en: Your shadow covers the whole leaf.
I shift a little to the leaf's underside.
Your fingers wait at the leaf's edge.
I hear the grass under your feet.
Come closer and I'll curl up.
There's nothing I can strike back with.
This chase is very short.
I can only retreat toward the leaf's heart.
Be careful not to crush me.
I wait for you to decide.
I bump you like a piece of leaf.

lines.zh: 我的身子蹭到你的手背
lines.en: My body brushes your hand's back.
That wouldn't even tickle.
I slip off the leaf and tap you.
I have nothing that can hurt.
It's me that got touched, not you.
I can only arch my body up.
This weight, you won't even feel.
I'm not attacking. I'm fleeing.
Don't squeeze. I'd burst.
I hatched from an egg.
I'm on a leaf in the forest.
Green. Easy to hide.
My first meal is leaf.
There are notches where I've bitten.
I won't leave this leaf.
When grown, I'll spin a cocoon.
The ground is too far for me.
I crawl slowly, seeking tender spots.
This forest has leaves in plenty.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的身子卷了
lines.en: The fire nears and my body curls.
I fall to the ground and can't move.
Water rises and I can't breathe.
The blast flips the whole leaf.
An arrow grazes the leaf and knocks me off.
That light leaves me numb all over.
No leaf, and I grow softer by the hour.
Lightning strikes the tree and I freeze.
The leaf is gone and I fall.
